long_description:
The Prompting Company helps companies get discovered and used by AI agents.

We help companies with two things:
- Discovery: We find the exact questions your customers ask AI, analyze whether your product shows up, and improve how AI systems describe and recommend you.
- Usability: We test whether AI agents can actually use your product, including finding the right docs, performing the right workflows, and completing tasks on behalf of users.
name: The Prompting Company
one_liner: We help products get discovered & used by AI agents.
